description: Compare the 10 best Adobe Illustrator alternatives in 2026. Find free and paid options for vector design.
body:
Adobe is without a doubt the industry standard for graphic design, and Adobe Illustrator is one of the most popular.

It is a commonly used tool from the Adobe Creative Cloud, but it is also quite expensive.

What are the best Illustrator alternatives?

As a designer, however, you'll still need the best software to build your portfolio and attract clients.

This is why I've created this list of the top Illustrator alternatives that are available today for creatives like you.

10 Best Illustrator Alternatives

  1. Inkscape—Best overall free alternative
  2. Gravit Designer—Best browser-based
  3. Affinity Designer—Best value
  4. BoxySVG—Best for SVG
  5. CorelDRAW—Most famous
  6. Vecteezy—Most manageable
  7. Vectr—Best for browser editing
  8. Vectornator—Best free
  9. GIMP—Best open-source
  10. Sketch—Best for UI design

How to choose the best Illustrator alternative

When choosing the best Illustrator alternative, there are a few things to keep in mind.

I will give you some ideas on how to choose the best alternative for you.

  1. Editing Tools
  2. File Support
  3. File Conversion
  4. Color Management
  5. Price and Affordability
  6. Preference

The first step in choosing the best software is to figure out what you need.

Make a list of qualities and categorize them as things you require and things you desire as alternatives.

Editing Tools

To speed up your productivity, select a set of tools that has everything you'll need to convey your creative vision in a single application.

File Support

Use software that has a lot of file support so you may use your files in a variety of programs that you use on a daily basis.

File Conversion

Converting low-resolution bitmaps to vector pictures is a common activity for designers, so this is an important function to look for in your design software.

Color Management

Competent color management helps ensure that color is accurately portrayed throughout the rest of the process.

Price

The second important thing that you should take into consideration is the price of the software.

Some of us prefer free software, and some are looking for a cheaper option.

There are several available Illustrator alternatives online, and your budget will dictate which of those is affordable for you.

Just make sure that the editing tool you choose meets your needs and preferences.

Preference

With the features and price given above, it always depends on your own preference and needs.

If you are a beginner, go for a simple and easy-to-learn Illustrator alternative such as Inkscape.

If you are a pro but wanted to try a free app, you can check out Vectornator.

If you have enough budget to avail CorelDRAW, you can try this impressive app.

It all depends on your work requirement, other tools may not be suitable for you but suitable to others.

Let's dive into my list of the free and paid top 10 best Illustrator alternatives for creatives.

1. Inkscape

Inkscape is the perfect tool for you if you're seeking for editing program that can work on even the most basic computers.

Inkscape is the best free overall Illustrator alternative.

It is free of cost and also a good Illustrator alternative for beginner artists.


It's a wonderful choice for anyone who wants to make digital illustrations and vector graphics for free.

‍Inkscape has a comprehensive tool kit and excellent format support.

It allows you to create outstanding designs with its pencil, text, and shape tools.

It includes a specific spirals tool, a tool for creating patterns and arrangements of clones.

Check out Inkscape, the best Illustrator alternative for budding creatives.

2. Gravit Designer

Gravit Designer is the best choice if you're seeking an Illustrator alternative with notable features like SVG editing and cloud connectivity.

Gravit Designer is the best free browser-based Illustrator alternative.

It is compatible with Windows, Mac OS, Chrome OS, and Linux.

This editing tool is also available both online and offline.

Gravit Designer can export and import files in a variety of formats.

It contains many of the same capabilities as Adobe Illustrator.

Users can work on their files from any device as long as they have access to a good internet connection.

Check out Gravit Designer, a free Illustrator alternative for vector designing.

3. Affinity Designer

if you are looking for an editing tool that can switch between vector, export, and pixel modes, Affinity Designer is a perfect choice.

Affinity Designers is the best value Illustrator alternative.

This software is compatible with Windows, iOS, and macOS.

Affinity Designer is compatible with Mac, Windows, and iPad and has been optimized for documents of any complexity.

It has incredible features like pan and zoom at 60 frames per second and real-time blend mode previews.

It is not just feature-rich and powerful, but it is also significantly less expensive than an Illustrator membership.

This software allows creatives to create works in three different personas: Designer Persona, Export Persona, and User Persona.

Check out Affinity Designer, an award-winning Illustrator alternative that is a good option for professional creatives.

4. BoxySVG

If you are looking for a great tool to edit SVG files, BoxySVG editor is the one.

BoxySVG is the best Illustrator alternative for Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG) files.

It is a free program that allows you to create scalable vector graphic files.

A paid subscription unlocks a Google Chrome extension that makes the web app work on any device and operating system.

It is less complicated than Illustrator; it is a faster and easier way to create vector graphic files.

You may use Boxy SVG to import and export JPEGs and PNGs in addition to SVG and SVGZ files.

Because of the simplicity of its user interface, it limits the list of options to only the most essential aspects.

Check out Boxy SVG, an excellent Illustrator alternative for beginners having a simple UI.

5. CorelDRAW

CorelDRAW is the perfect tool if you are looking for an all-in-one design editing tool that works on Windows, iOS, Mac, iPad, and mobile devices.

CorelDRAW is the most famous Illustrator alternative.

It is undoubtedly the most well-known Adobe Illustrator rival, having been released over three decades ago.

CorelDRAW is cheaper than Adobe Illustrator, but it is still more expensive compared to other programs on my list.

Both software is jam-packed with features and has ardent supporters.

It's a cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that has similar design capabilities as Adobe apps.

But they have entirely different interfaces and approaches.

Check out CorelDRAW, the fastest Illustrator alternative software on the market.

6. Vecteezy

Vecteezy is the best fit if you are looking for a web-based illustration tool that does not require any installation.

Vecteezy is the most simple Illustrator alternative.

It has a free web-based version that can be used by beginners and experts with ease and convenience.

You may import and modify SVG files, or you can start from scratch and create your own designs using this Illustrator alternative.

There are many shapes and ready-made clipart to choose from, as well as typefaces for text-based projects.

‍Vecteezy includes a pen tool for sketching freehand forms, altering existing routes, and rudimentary color picker,

To save your work, you'll need to establish an account or connect with Facebook.

Check out Vecteezy, the Illustrator alternative for creatives who enjoys creating stylish designs.

7. Vectr

Vectr is a good alternative if you're a newbie attempting to make a digital graphics with lesser time and effort.

Vectr is the best Illustrator alternative for browser editing.

It is a free online application that allows you to get started with vector editing quickly and easily.

Vectr is a completely free, simple, and browser-based illustration tool with an intuitive UI.

It was created as a simple-to-learn and simple-to-use replacement to Adobe Illustrator.

Simple vector editing is one of the main features of this tool and is also ideal for beginners.

But, this software is only compatible with Chrome and lacks certain advanced capabilities.

Check out Vectr, a simple and easy-to-use Illustrator alternative that allows you to collaborate with other artists.

8. Vectornator

Vectornator is one of the most popular illustrators on the App Store, with millions of users around the globe.

Vectornator is one of the best free Illustrator alternatives.

It is entirely free to download, and you can begin right away once it has been downloaded.


Having a contextual quick action menu and quick action tab, designing is simple and quick using this Illustrator alternative.

Individual layers can be exported as well in different formats such as AI, PDF, SVG, PNG, and JPG.

With Vectornator, you may use the Brush Tool to sign your name, just like you would with a real pen.

It has infinite artboards and powerful text editing tools.

Check out Vectornator, an Illustrator alternative that has become a go-to tool for millions of designers.

9. GIMP

GIMP is a powerful and free photo editor ideal for budget-conscious creatives.

GIMP is the best open-source Illustrator alternative.

It is a free online program for image retouching and photo editing.

MacOS, Windows, Linux, Sun OpenSolaris, and FreeBSD are all supported by this program.

The  software's interface is customizable, you can change it by reducing the number of windows and toolbars.

Just like other Adobe applications, GIMP offers Curves, Levels, Dodge and Burn, and a variety of image changes.

Check out GIMP, one of the best free Illustrator alternatives which is ideal for any creative.

10. Sketch

If you are looking for excellent software for your UI designs, then Sketch will be the best fit.

Sketch is the best Illustrator alternative for UI design.

As the original Adobe Photoshop competitor, it is great for UI and icon design, easy to use, and user-friendly software.

Sketch is designed for vector designers, but if you need basic editing features, it is also a good fit.

It isn't a full-featured drawing program so it lacks certain of Illustrator's capabilities.

But if you are using a Mac, this is probably the ultimate alternative you are looking for.

By using this editing tool, you can export files in multiple formats and sizes, as well as create and edit vector artworks faster and easier.

Check out Sketch, the best Illustrator alternative suitable for UI, UX, web, and app designers.

Conclusions

The Adobe Illustrator CC is the greatest vector editor overall.

There's no substitute for industry-standard vector editing software if you're a professional designer or artist.

However, I understand that we all have different preferences, and some of you may be looking for budget-friendly or free software solutions.

What is the best Illustrator alternative?

Inkscape and Gravit Designer are two of the best Adobe Illustrator alternatives.

Some apps are better than others; not every program can meet your creative needs.

You have to carefully choose which alternative will perfectly fit your needs as an artist.

I hope this article about the 10 best Illustrator alternatives helps you find the best option for you.
